description.value:
(Prerequisite: Eberron Campaign, Can't Have Another Dragonmark Feat)

The Mark of Finding of House Tharashk manifests on your skin. You gain the following benefits.

Hunter's Intuition. When you make a Wisdom (Perception or Survival) check, you can roll 1d4 and add the number rolled to the check.

Finder's Magic. @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplHuntersMar]{Hunter's Mark} is always prepared for you. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain that use when you finish a Long Rest; you can also cast it with any spell slots of the appropriate level you have. Your spellcasting ability for this spell is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (chosen when you take this feat). From character level 3, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLocateObje]{Locate Object} is also always prepared for you, and you can cast it the same way.

Spells of the Mark. If you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the spells on the Mark of Finding Spells table are added to that feature's spell list.

3@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplClairvoyan]{Clairvoyance}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplSpeakwithP]{Speak with Plants}
4@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDivination]{Divination}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplLocateCrea]{Locate Creature}
5@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplCommunewit]{Commune with Nature}

Foundry Note

The effect Hunter's Intuition adds the 1d4 to the Perception and Survival checks. The spells of character level 3 are granted when you reach that level: choose the same spellcasting ability as for the others. The Spells of the Mark are not added to your class spell list automatically: prepare them from the compendium if your class can.
